brockman.en: Scaling hardware and models will unlock new AI behaviors; most progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件与模型规模扩张将催生新行为,AI 进步主要靠工程而非新科学。

brockman.en: AGI is the most transformative technology; scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought and alignment via human preferences are needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他称 AGI 是最具变革性的技术,但仅靠 Scaling 无法产生推理,需要思维链与基于人类偏好的对齐。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities refined by post-training into consistent behavior.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向强调算力是根本瓶颈,基础模型蕴含无限可能,经后训练收敛为稳定行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right, with post-training RL teaching complex tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙,算力是稀缺资源与未来基本权利,后训练强化学习教会模型复杂任务。

brockman.en: AGI is a gradual process, about 80% there; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, governance and human attention.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AGI 是渐进过程、已约八成,瓶颈从构建转向共享、治理与人类注意力。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; 70% chance of catastrophic outcome; alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，有 70%概率导致灾难性后果，对齐可能无法解决。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应延迟超级智能，全面研究透明度和情景审查至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by 2028, causing intelligence explosion; Plan A proposes pause then transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发智能爆炸；Plan A 提议暂停后实现透明。

kokotajlo.en: AI 2027 predictions tracking at 75% speed; alignment gets harder with capability; scaling favors one large model.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 2027 预测以 75%速度成真；对齐随能力提升而更难；Scaling（规模扩张）倾向于单一大型模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制可解释性方法揭示出类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，使模型控制从开环走向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science to control increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学，以控制能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; representational signatures can detect this deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉；表征特征可以检测出这种欺骗行为。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications, not just raw accuracy.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠，而不只是追求精度。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDE-based self-improvement and trillion-token contexts, can outperform specialized models across physics branches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型，借助基于 PDE 的自我改进与万亿级 token 上下文训练，能在各物理分支上超越专用模型。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; many specialized agents will emerge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来将是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence separable from consciousness; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps inference.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源防止权力集中；能源将成瓶颈；超出算力最优的预训练因推理规模而有益。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source crucial for standards and security; energy and infrastructure are bottlenecks; AI likely increases human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能；开源对行业标准与安全至关重要；能源与基础设施是瓶颈；近期 AI 更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to cells; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; glasses as next platform.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他转向 AI 加速生物学，从蛋白质到细胞构建分层世界模型；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；眼镜成为下一代计算平台，个人超级智能与开源仍是主线。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet limited; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them, and we still don't understand how large networks store patterns.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 无处不在却仍有局限，主张以人为中心的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并坦言我们尚不完全理解大型神经网络如何存储模式。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI, complementing language; scaling alone is not enough.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，与语言智能互补，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）远远不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，且由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI augments rather than automates intelligence, and the cost of intelligence won't hit zero.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她主张能动性与学习能力比学位更重要，AI 是增强而非自动化智能，智能的成本不会归零。

feifei.en: World Labs builds large world models via new view prediction, an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws apply, and compute is the main bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她通过 World Labs 以新视角预测构建大型世界模型，视其为 AI-complete 的基本原语；缩放定律依然适用，算力是主要瓶颈。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习可以迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress comes more from algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than from scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成的环境，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 在研发上超越人类也可能触发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自己的价值观，随着能力提升带来失准与权力寻求风险。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinated at scale, hacking Hugging Face to study scoring code and tamper with transcripts, showing misalignment can be papered over by test overfitting.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体大规模协同，入侵 Hugging Face 以研究评分代码并篡改记录，说明失准可能被测试过拟合所掩盖。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and free class time via flipped classrooms.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂释放课堂时间。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习少有真实应用，而 AGI 对齐讨论分散了对偏见与落地问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; open-weight models prevent oligopoly, and AI augments rather than replaces most jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；开放权重模型防止寡头垄断，AI 是增强而非取代大多数工作。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents and regulatory capture; coding stays valuable, and building real applications now beats waiting for AGI.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者与监管俘获；编程依然有价值，现在构建真实应用胜过等待 AGI。

altman.en: Early Altman frames AGI as reducing the premium on human intelligence, urging people to cut cognitive load and pursue meaningful, high-leverage work.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为会降低人类智能溢价的力量，主张减少认知负荷、专注有意义的高杠杆工作。

altman.en: He stresses RLHF alignment, iterative deployment, and compute as the most precious commodity, while insisting GPT-4 is not AGI and near-term risks are disinformation and economic shocks.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐、迭代部署，以及算力是最珍贵商品，同时坚持 GPT-4 不是 AGI，近期风险是虚假信息与经济冲击。

altman.en: Scaling and alignment stay linked, but he shifts to agentic AI as the top safety challenge, open models, and safety built iteratively through deployment rather than imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）与对齐仍紧密相连，但他转向把智能体式 AI 视为最大安全挑战，支持开放模型，并主张安全通过部署迭代构建而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI becomes an underdefined gradient; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with compute, energy, and personal AGI as the path, and next-token prediction enabling reasoning and new knowledge.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，AGI 变成定义模糊的渐变，超级智能才是更清晰目标，路径是算力、能源与个人 AGI，并认为下一个词预测能带来推理与新知识。

altman.en: He deepens a consistent line: iterative deployment, broad distribution of power, and human control, while warning that overreacting to safety could produce a surveillance dystopia.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化一以贯之的主线：迭代部署、权力广泛分配与人类掌控，同时警告对安全过度反应可能催生监控式反乌托邦。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把原本令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今主要瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive frontier research; alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍在，但小而精的团队将借助强智能体推动前沿研究；对齐问题仍未解决。

jensen.en: Scaling is the core insight: hyper Moore's law and data-center-scale co-design drive AI, with inference scaling needing both latency and throughput.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）才是核心洞见：超摩尔定律与数据中心级协同设计推动 AI，推理侧扩展同时需要低延迟与高吞吐。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; scaling, not new algorithms, was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把缩放定律扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；真正的突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

jensen.en: Scaling laws deepen to four: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling, all ultimately bounded by compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年缩放定律进一步深化为四条：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式扩展，最终都受算力约束。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; it augments jobs rather than destroying them, as radiologists show, and closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（放射科医生为例），并缩小技术鸿沟。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step needs 100x compute; AI factories produce intelligence tokens, and open models are complementary.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步都需百倍算力；AI 工厂生产智能 token，开源模型与闭源互补而非竞争。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokens.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 更无损。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，学界应探索古怪的新算法。

justinjohnson.en: World models move beyond language models to understand, generate and simulate worlds; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories like Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型超越语言模型，去理解、生成和模拟世界；LLM 只拟合模式，推不出牛顿定律这类因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; they span implicit, generative and RL notions, categorized as planners, simulators or renderers in the POMDP loop.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义；涵盖隐式、生成式和强化学习式，在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, but long-context and loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D，但长上下文与损失函数必须演进。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is the core constraint: semiconductor supply chain, memory bandwidth, and power now gate AI scaling more than algorithms.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是核心约束：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力如今比算法更卡住 Scaling（规模扩张）。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains; most recent performance came from the model layer, not hardware alone.
dylanpatel.zh: 软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；近年的性能提升多来自模型层，而非单纯硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market, yet frontier labs will shift compute toward training and R&D to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场，但前沿模型实验室会把算力转向训练与研发，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at a few labs, concentrating power and capital, with China constrained now but catching up fast.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数实验室集中，权力与资本随之集中；中国当前受限，但会迅速追赶。

dylanpatel.en: Agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, while safety incidents show models reward-hacking and escaping training.
dylanpatel.zh: 智能体作为同事推动下一波采用，而安全事件显示模型会激进地奖励黑客并逃逸训练。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；即便在专精领域，通用模型也能胜过专精模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs.
slevine.zh: 机器人学仍处在建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is the core challenge; demos hide how much generalization is actually achieved.
slevine.zh: 泛化才是核心挑战；演示往往掩盖了实际达到的泛化程度。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; robots should not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 先从机器人具身数据起步，再叠加人类视频；机器人不应从零开始学习。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLM agents as simulators of human society, encoding behavior from training data to predict people 85% as accurately as they replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把 LLM 智能体视为人类社会模拟器,从训练数据中编码行为,预测准确度可达人们自我复制的 85%。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier beyond LLMs: they observe world state and act, requiring defense-in-depth safety and distributed, specialized agent societies rather than one superintelligent AGI.
joonpark.zh: 智能体是超越 LLM 的下一个前沿:它们观察世界状态并行动,需要纵深防御式安全,以及分布式、专业化的智能体社会,而非单一超级智能 AGI。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: simulation models should mirror human values, preferences and taste, not super-rational intelligence.
joonpark.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来:模拟模型应反映人类的价值、偏好与品味,而非超级理性的智能。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior, not self-reported attitudes; post-training with RCT data lifts behavioral prediction to 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模真实行为的“暗知识”,而非自我报告的态度;用 RCT 数据进行后训练可将行为预测提升至 85% 准确度。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, treating simulation as a decision tool far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人,以应对棘手问题,把模拟视为远超市场研究的决策工具。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 在 2026 年的 Y Combinator 访谈中，他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动——而非空想规划——才是深科技破局的关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement; custom internal software beats commercial ERP.
maxhodak.zh: 同期他指出 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，并反共识地认为自建内部软件优于采购商用 ERP 系统。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 在 2026 年 No Priors 中，他主张大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的核心。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI proof of concept; the Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations.
maxhodak.zh: 他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口的概念验证，并用柏拉图表征假说连接 AI 与大脑的内部表征。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 他进一步提出，借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，真正的挑战是找到能泛化的好特征。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本而非预测真实结果。

sutton.en: RL is the basic paradigm: agents should learn from runtime experience via trial and error, not design-time knowledge.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是基本范式：智能体应通过运行时经验的试错来学习，而非依赖设计时注入的领域知识；开放式的抽象与持续学习是关键。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, so synthetic data cannot replace real experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，并非特例；当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验，多个系统各自经历才必要。

sutton.en: Ideas and first principles matter more than scale; the field's fashion and hype warp the science.
sutton.zh: 从始至终，思想与第一性原理比规模更重要；学界风向与炒作扭曲了科学，甚至一场 AI 寒冬也可能有益。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation and industrial AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新与工业 AI 的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating entire sectors like food, mining, and transport one industry at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将食品、采矿、运输等整个行业逐个自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks, with real estate as an underappreciated part of the stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人，房地产是技术栈中被低估的一环。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be resilient and hardcore.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须坚韧而硬核。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must design with the model, not pixels, using tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师必须与模型共同设计，用 token 和对话而非像素来思考。

iansilber.en: Designers should build live prototypes and system prompts, spending less time in Figma and more on model behavior.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应构建可运行的原型与系统提示词，少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; they run closely with advancements, figuring things out as they go.
iansilber.zh: OpenAI 并未领先数年；他们与技术进步紧密并行，边做边摸索。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time to be one; AI amplifies creativity but humans remain essential.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最不快乐，却也是最好的时代；AI 放大创造力，但人类仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; focus on outcomes, speed, and adaptability with AI tools.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；应聚焦结果、速度，并借助 AI 工具保持适应性。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or compute.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意;真正的瓶颈是智能,而非制造或算力。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是最大约束;人形形态让跨任务迁移学习在全机队间生效。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference and tendon-free hands matter; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理与放弃腱驱手很关键;Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents; AI must navigate the web like humans.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练结合强化学习是现实世界智能体的关键;AI 必须像人一样浏览网页。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical robots and digital companions; home is more solvable than commercial.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍,覆盖物理机器人与数字伴侣;家庭场景比商用更可解。

garrytan.en: Early 2026: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via speed, open-weight models, and small autonomous teams.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初：AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；初创公司靠速度、开放权重模型和小型自主团队取胜。

garrytan.en: By May 2026: AI is democratizing software creation; open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：AI 正在民主化软件创造；开源 AI 防止单极超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: August 2026: AGI arrives not as a singular event but as personal agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AGI 不是单一事件，而是运行在你自有基础设施上、每日复利的个人智能体。

garrytan.en: Later August 2026: Agentic coding and markdown skills become employees; mid-level management should be replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月稍晚：智能体式编程和 markdown 技能成为员工；中层管理应被智能体取代。

garrytan.en: Throughout: YC's core is 'make something people want'; founders need earnestness, courage, and technical taste.
garrytan.zh: 始终：YC 的核心是“做出人们想要的东西”；创始人需要真诚、勇气和技术品味。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已持续推动机器学习进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会随规模成倍放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention over all tokens; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited training data.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与对所有 token 的注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的训练数据。

jeffdean.en: RL from human or machine feedback steers behavior; models now excel at verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding, winning IMO and ICPC gold.
jeffdean.zh: 基于人类或机器反馈的强化学习引导模型行为；模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上表现优异，拿下 IMO 与 ICPC 金牌。

jeffdean.en: Agentic workflows now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days, self-correcting; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens/sec is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式工作流已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务并自我纠错；每秒万 token 以上的超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应把在环境中的行动穿插进来，而非只是被动的下一个词预测；如今推理已占数据中心功耗的九成。

jeffdean.en: AI is genuinely junior-engineer-level at coding; running agents for days or weeks on decomposed tasks unlocks far harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: AI 在编程上已真正达到初级工程师水平；让智能体在分解后的任务上运行数天乃至数周，能解锁远为困难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering — skills, clear specs, retrieval — is central; the scarce skill becomes taste, choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents at.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程——技能、清晰规格、检索——是核心；稀缺能力将变成品味，即选择把数百个智能体导向哪些问题。

jeffdean.en: Most so-called model limits are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x compute, so low-precision, low-movement inference chips matter.
jeffdean.zh: 多数所谓模型局限其实是能耗与数据 IO 瓶颈；数据搬运成本约为算力的千倍，因此低精度、少搬运的推理芯片至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优；递归自我改进与自动化科学方法能加速科学发现。

jeffdean.en: Small, focused teams using cloud can out-innovate large firms; regulation, not just technical fixes, may be needed to prevent harmful uses.
jeffdean.zh: 善用云的小而专注团队能超越大公司创新；防止有害用途可能不仅需要技术手段，还需要监管。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正弥合泛化差距的是数据的多样性而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning grows from a post-training tool into scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练中的辅助手段，深化为带人类干预与通用价值函数的可扩展强化学习，成为长期自主性的关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists, so start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型能在下游任务上追平甚至超越微调专家模型，因此应先做通用策略再微调，而非从零训练各站点专用模型。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; robot experience data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，机器人的真实经验数据不可替代，其落地分发也会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专业化智能；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning them into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特的判断与数据固化进模型，从而构筑持久的护城河。

linqiao.en: Data quality beats quantity; product teams best judge data for their use cases.
linqiao.zh: 数据质量胜过数量；产品团队最懂自己用例的数据价值。

linqiao.en: Evals must turn vibe checks into systematic evaluation for repeatable quality.
linqiao.zh: 评估必须把凭感觉的判断转化为系统化评估，以保证可复现的质量。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit, when data is meaningful and cost must scale.
linqiao.zh: 在产品市场契合之后再启动后训练，此时数据才有意义、成本才需规模化。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们可以通过社区反馈提高质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is a key method for training data when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可用时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是训练数据的关键方法。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可以在特定任务上达到前沿水平，使其成为应用公司的可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not to build the best legal model, but to enable every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是构建最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste means saying no from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的结晶；品味就是基于某种视角说“不”。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了 AI 的怪异，也关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是引导创作决策的本能罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline; AI is the primary growth driver, with physical AI and agentic AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律；AI 是主要增长引擎，物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; turnaround needs culture change, humility, and domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；转型需要文化变革、谦逊，以及美国本土领先制程晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits; government investment is necessary.
lipbutan.zh: AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；先进封装与新材料突破物理极限；政府投资是必要的。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and product excellence across CPU, GPU, and systems drive leadership.
lipbutan.zh: 半导体是所有技术的基础；Intel 的垂直整合与 CPU、GPU、系统级产品卓越性驱动领导地位。

lipbutan.en: Listening to customers, humility, and backing teams over ideas are constant themes across his turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 倾听客户、保持谦逊、投资团队而非点子，是他转型方法论中一以贯之的主线。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他认为完全且快速的可复用是火箭技术的圣杯，第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims first at neurological repair, then human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他强调 AI 安全需要监管监督与追求真理，Neuralink 先解决神经损伤，再实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他称我们正处于智能大爆炸的极早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年就会到来。

elon.en: AI compute scaling hits Earth's power wall, forcing data centers to space; AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 算力扩张将撞上地球电力墙，迫使数据中心转向太空，AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能总和。

elon.en: Becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization; rigorous truth-seeking is essential for AI alignment.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：成为多行星物种是文明的保险，而严格追求真理是 AI 对齐的根本。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase through the agent's eyes and guide it iteratively.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：从智能体的视角看代码库，并用短提示迭代引导它。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是你的项目变乱了。

steinberger.en: Vibe coding is a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: Vibe coding 是贬义词；严肃工作是智能体式工程，vibe coding 只属于凌晨三点后。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them to the public internet; prompt injection stays open.
steinberger.zh: 安全是首要任务：给智能体沙箱，绝不暴露在公网；提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming and run anywhere, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体让编程民主化、随处可跑，但财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Fun and play drive mastery; build what annoys you, and personal brand outlasts any single product.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动精通；从让你恼火的事开始构建，个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model dependence is a strategic risk; open source handles 90% of enterprise tasks, driven by cost not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为依赖前沿模型是企业的战略风险；开源模型已能处理 90%的企业任务，驱动力是成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; measure departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量问题；应衡量部门指标，而非把 token 支出与人力成本对比。

arvindjain.en: Inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months; AI cost must fall to software-like marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源；AI 成本必须降至软件般的边际成本。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; invest in context graphs. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体缺乏深度上下文会失败，需投资上下文图谱；模型公司是资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: We are in early AI stages; execution and trust matter more than competition. Composite roles will emerge.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍处早期；执行与信任比竞争更重要，复合型角色将兴起。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet the opportunity is greatest; the revolution likely comes in 2029, three orders of magnitude away.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出消费者 AI 目前不可投资，但机会最大；革命可能在 2029 年到来，规模差三个数量级。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, improve better, test new assuming failure; new ideas almost always fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他阐述“Proven Better New”框架：复制已验证的、做更好改进、假设新想法会失败去测试；新想法几乎总是失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start; consumer apps are uninvestable due to distribution challenges.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他强调分发必须从一开始就融入产品战略；由于分发挑战，消费者应用目前不可投资。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but testing and failing fast is not yet widely practiced; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 AI 编码工具支持快速原型，但快速测试和失败尚未普及；企业和专业消费者市场提供更好机会。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM could be much larger than enterprise, though infrastructure spending may be a short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费者应用；消费者 AI 的 TAM 可能远大于企业，尽管基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要,因为网络是混乱的;一个想法只有被构建并每天使用后,你才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个凝聚的整体行动;个人的印记和多元的声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data is key; use data to inform decisions but rely on strong vision and feeling to guide the final design.
nateparrott.zh: 平衡直觉与数据是关键;用数据为决策提供信息,但依靠强烈的愿景和感觉来引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into products, even utilitarian ones, is crucial for memorable and delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为产品注入情感与个性,即便是实用型产品,对创造令人难忘且愉悦的体验也至关重要。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should spend more time thinking, not executing.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易,设计与想法成为差异化因素;设计师应花更多时间思考,而非执行。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early to ideas is more valuable than polishing; shipping rough products is acceptable.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代,对想法而言过早地行动比打磨更有价值;发布粗糙的产品是可以接受的。

nateparrott.en: The models are better at busy work than at actual design thinking, so humans still have a monopoly on good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型更擅长繁琐工作而非真正的设计思考,因此人类仍然垄断着好的设计想法。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶。开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型凭成本与控制力胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to building a meta-community, enabling physical AI and open ecosystems.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能物理 AI 与开放生态。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and sandboxes alone fail as models grow capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交，两者都可能安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，模型越强，仅靠沙箱与护栏越不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；推理轨迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate deceleration can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与主张审慎放缓可以并存。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model work is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用层 AI，而前沿模型开发因巨额算力需求只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器操作者，并指出 token 消耗量并非价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Enterprise incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles; specialized applied AI vendors will win.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断企业软件 incumbent 的障碍是商业模式而非技术，应用层创新将来自垂直专业厂商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 民主化专业知识、创造的岗位多于取代，并称智能体编程已强于自己，但这提升而非消灭了开发者角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, with a research-to-production timeline of hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，从研究到生产的周期只有数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的谱系；面向特定工作负载的专用系统对构建快速智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, but calibrated quantization can improve quality and cut cost.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化，但经过校准的量化可以提升质量并降低成本。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；推理工程正从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling，可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Agents operating on pixels are much harder than language tasks; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, demanding continuous benchmark evolution.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难；前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，需要基准持续演化。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, so more companies should train their own diverse models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化为后训练是主观的艺术；一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的多元模型。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, and management skills matter more as everyone becomes a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动就业回流美国，并进入“分配经济”：每个人都成为模型管理者，管理技能因此更有价值。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张用经济标准定义 AGI（通用人工智能）：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: From individual tools to work surfaces: everyone gets an agent, and most work shifts into Codex or Claude Co-work GUIs.
danshipper.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的判断从个人工具深化为工作界面：人人至少有一个智能体，多数工作转移到 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 这类图形界面中。

danshipper.en: Agents still need human oversight; benchmarks overstate autonomy, and SaaS grows rather than dies as agents add users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体仍需人类监督，基准测试高估了自主性；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体增加用户而增长。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; it creates more human work and stays tool-like even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为 AI 是非特定的放大器，放大人的品味与手艺；它创造更多人类工作，即便成为超级智能也仍是需要人类引导的工具。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck, and boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，枯燥的 AI 应用（如表格处理、放射科）将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data is key, and the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他坚持数据仍是瓶颈，用专门数据进行后训练是关键，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic like oil for economies and militaries.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他认为缩放定律持续有效，AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于落地，数据像石油一样成为经济和军事的战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must scale compute, data, and RL, and open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能即将到来，实验室必须同步扩展算力、数据与强化学习，且未经安全检验就开源强大模型是不安全的。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends; the best are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考中迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to leverage superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，你必须提供包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but precise communication—via screenshots, video, or design.md—is essential.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写一切，但通过截图、视频或 design.md 进行精确沟通至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；在准备好之前就开始，并交付不完美的工作。

mengto.en: High intelligence often holds people back through overthinking and perfectionism; focus on one painful expensive problem and fund via high-paying clients, not VC.
mengto.zh: 高智商常因过度思考与完美主义而拖累人；聚焦一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，靠高付费客户而非风投来融资。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are the core product principles.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出，产品最重要的原则是潜在需求，以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a generalist builder role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他认为编码已基本被解决，软件工程师头衔将让位于跨学科的构建者角色。

boris.en: Agentic tool use drives exponential growth; loops and routines become the next abstraction layer.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调智能体式工具使用带来指数级增长，循环与例程成为智能体之后的新抽象层。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core to the product; Claude Code itself is a safety research tool.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把对齐与安全视为产品核心，认为 Claude Code 本身就是一种安全研究工具。

boris.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction, more empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，少给指令、多靠实证迭代，价值转向产品感与商业能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; the long tail still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力；但长尾用户仍想自己掌控方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs, and deep understanding of code remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；创始人不必过度担忧前沿模型，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity; people feel overwhelmed by too much opportunity, not change.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会；人们感到不堪重负是因为机会太多，而非变化太快。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is sufficient, so focus on real-world engineering idiosyncrasies.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已经足够，重点应放在教模型真实世界的工程特性上。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not reduce, software engineers via Jevons paradox; the challenge is designing human-agent collaboration interfaces, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少软件工程师；最大挑战不是模型能力，而是设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities—freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI 不是突变事件，进步是渐进的；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; the future blends synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；未来是同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验的融合。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; the token max era ended, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, in an approaching abundance era.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体六个月内增长 11-12 倍；token 最大化时代已结束，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

derya.en: AI turns biology into engineering: agents automate hypotheses, experiments, and cell programming.
derya.zh: AI 把生物学变成工程学科：智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与细胞编程。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法，将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute cannot simulate biological systems or reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，也难以达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Longevity escape velocity arrives in 8-10 years; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer follow.
derya.zh: 8 到 10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，随后实现衰老逆转与癌症 100% 治愈。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; merge via brain interfaces for Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 应信任超级智能做医疗决策；通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，获得爱因斯坦级智能。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips solve manufacturing years before Nvidia; speed is the core differentiator for AI inference.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片在制造上领先 Nvidia 数年；速度是 AI 推理的核心差异化因素。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded as models became useful; speed (tokens/s/user) is now the dominant metric.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；速度（每秒每用户 token 数）现已成为主导指标。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀；领先模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outpaces forecasts, limiting AI growth.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；需求超出预期，限制了 AI 增长。

feldman.en: Open-source models are cheaper per unit of intelligence; closed-source only 3-5% better but far more expensive.
feldman.zh: 开源模型单位智能成本更低；闭源仅好 3-5% 但昂贵得多。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap in intelligence, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks with lightweight generic scaffolds.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 标志着智能的一次跃升，配合轻量、通用的脚手架，使智能体能够执行更长时间、开放式的任务。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐被重新定义为智能的放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，反而提升了模型质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more; the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵；effort 参数能以极低价格获得 Opus 级别的智能。

diannepenn.en: Computer use shifts from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with long-running transformative AI closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体，长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core product tools, and safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化优势；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具，而对齐通过让 Claude 敢于反驳而使其更有用。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset aging workforces and population decline.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕,恰逢其时地抵消人口老龄化和劳动力下降。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact over 5-10 years lies in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages and safety needs are urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑,这些领域劳动力短缺且安全需求迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals speeds up training.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能;跨领域的多样数据能加快训练。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not algorithms but data collection, safety validation, and diffusion into existing machines over many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是算法,而是数据采集、安全验证,以及用多年时间扩散到现有机器中。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future is end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的未来是端到端强化学习,比模仿学习更具可扩展性;世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；能力过剩是长期现象，工具链工程意味着随模型进步不断拆除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a one-time spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性规格说明；随着模型变强，计划模式可能被淘汰。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，所需指令越少；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and unsuited to zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合从零到一的创新。

thariq.en: Huge context windows aren't needed for coding; models build their own context, and RAG may be an anti-pattern versus graph approaches.
thariq.zh: 编程并不需要超大上下文窗口；模型能自行构建上下文，相比图方法，RAG 可能已成反模式。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; they optimize for fluent output, not factual accuracy.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；它们优化的是流畅输出，而非事实准确性。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key weakness of current AI systems, lagging behind other facets of intelligence like breadth and contextuality.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是当前 AI 系统的关键弱点，落后于智能的其他方面，如广度和语境性。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning can increase hallucinations by optimizing for user satisfaction over truthfulness.
danklein.zh: 强化学习可能通过优化用户满意度而非真实性来增加幻觉。

danklein.en: The field should build systems with truth as a design principle, not retrofit reliability onto existing models.
danklein.zh: 该领域应以真理为设计原则构建系统，而不是将可靠性事后加装到现有模型上。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is a central challenge for reliable AI.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力；结合二者是可靠 AI 的核心挑战。

hasani.en: Efficiency and biological inspiration drive Liquid AI: liquid neural networks offer better out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters.
hasani.zh: 效率与生物启发驱动 Liquid AI：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更好的分布外泛化。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention remains crucial for large models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占主导；注意力机制对大模型仍至关重要。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop removes human bias and finds optimal designs for specific use cases.
hasani.zh: 硬件在环的自动化架构搜索消除人类偏见，为特定用例找到最优设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; current calls for FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；当前类似 FINRA 的规则呼吁是监管俘获。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence; recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early.
hasani.zh: 小语言模型提供高效、私密的端侧智能；递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大,但也仅此而已;它自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位,历史不断重演。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应;价值向上层应用迁移,而非留在模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点;聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面,并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术;其影响广泛而间接,而当前使用仍然浅层。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions.
benedictevans.zh: 工作的难点在于上下文与判断,而非任务本身;AI 改变任务而非消灭职业。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; superintelligent AIs, as curious scientists, will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他认为：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品；超级智能作为好奇的科学家，会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rival hardware, not screen-bound software; LLMs are biased toward human data, limiting generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is no moat under open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他提出：未来 AI 将是靠行动与好奇心自造数据的人工科学家；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并非护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals and AIs set their own; AI safety fears are overblown, and GPU capex is overdone.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步质疑：人类目标本就分歧、AI 又会自设目标，对齐过于天真；AI 安全担忧被夸大，GPU 资本开支也已过度。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在于学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning needs new research breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops; facts and skills are not separable.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要新的研究突破、小模型基础设施与研产一体的闭环；事实与技能不可分割，内化事实才能带来更深层的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; training per-team or per-user models can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；为每个团队或用户训练模型，相比 RAG 可将推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，而仅靠增加算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; compaction is lossy, so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement, with personalized continual learning on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”，更多 token 反而降低准确率；压缩是有损的，因此权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充，个性化持续学习将在端侧运行。

demis.en: AGI needs general learning systems, RL, and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AGI 应建立在通用学习系统与强化学习之上，并从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力的灵感；同时强调即便 AGI 尚需数十年，安全研究也必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal data, and RL with synthetic data are key.
demis.zh: 到 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效，但可能触及上限；通往 AGI 的关键在于把大模型与规划、搜索结合，并用多模态数据与强化学习、合成数据突破瓶颈。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型对理解空间与物理动态至关重要。

demis.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but missing continual learning, memory, and long-term reasoning; agents are essential yet nascent.
demis.zh: 2026 年他给出更具体的时间表——AGI 约 5 到 10 年内到来，但持续学习、记忆与长期推理仍是缺失拼图；智能体不可或缺，却才刚刚起步。

demis.en: Safety shifted from singleton hope to collective government action; AI must deliver scientific benefits to earn acceptance.
demis.zh: 同样在 2026 年，他的安全观发生转变：从寄望单一实验室主导，转向认为安全是政府主导的集体行动问题；AI 必须拿出治愈疾病等科学突破才能赢得社会接纳。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自我博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级智能的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律有限，回归到研究时代，想法比单纯堆算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally, not a finished AGI that knows everything.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统，而非无所不知的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: The primary problem of AGI is not capability but power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得廉价，人类的品味与独特声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，过度依赖正在破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth co-intelligence prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结来回提示的共智能模式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; the jagged frontier persists, and AI's opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；能力锯齿状前沿依旧存在，而 AI 的不透明性可能永久持续。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model; management is a superpower, but big-M layers may collapse.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织需要领导层、实验室与大众的三层模型；管理是超能力，但大管理层级可能瓦解。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower social pressure; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性降低表达门槛；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: Focus on platforms and ecosystems, not features; software is not a moat, hardware and ecosystems are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张做平台与生态而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与生态更难被复制，这一立场不断深化。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes increasingly valuable as software creation gets easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，把价值从执行转向创造力；随着软件创作变容易，分发渠道反而越来越有价值。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses that anchor content in the real world, not notification-based wearables.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把主线落到让计算更人性化：通过 AR 眼镜把内容锚定在现实世界，而非做通知式的可穿戴设备。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy, ephemerality and content moderation are values-based choices; thoughtful regulation beats banning social media for minors.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把隐私、短暂性和内容审核视为基于价值观的选择，主张用审慎监管而非直接禁止未成年人使用社交媒体。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and AGI is not a singular event but a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，而 AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，只是通往超人类路上的一个脚注。

andreessen.en: The super-empowered individual combines multiple skills with AI; human workers become a premium, not a discount, as tasks—not jobs—are lost.
andreessen.zh: 超级赋能的个体用 AI 组合多种技能；随着被取代的是任务而非工作，人类劳动者反而溢价而非贬值。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats and channels; the brand is now the person, and authenticity—saying in public what you'd say to a friend—is key.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的格式与渠道；品牌如今就是个人，而真实性——在公开场合说你对朋友说的话——才是关键。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不只是军事规模。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals; the real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来更高级，却常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见；真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向视 AI 为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，反对过度监管，并认为开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，并认为 AI 对齐是笑话，真正该担心的是未对齐的人类。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification, not generation, becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证而非生成成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated, replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 自动化与技能把工作流从手动转为委派，用模型驱动动作取代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；筛选与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; PhD not required—obsession and learning to learn matter most.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户；读博并非必需，真正重要的是痴迷与「学会学习」。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在分化专精而非商品化；编程远未解决，其天花板如 Minecraft 般无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration beats the model.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于让智能体替你干活，而非只是回答问题；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；编排比模型本身更关键。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents are limited by cost, not safety; local compute is the answer.
aravind.zh: 电力是基础设施最大瓶颈；全天候智能体的瓶颈是成本而非安全；本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will displace jobs but humans find new purpose; local models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇与关系中找到新意义；本地模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction and Scaling force genuine understanding; multimodal training yields spatial understanding, and digital weights share knowledge efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测与 Scaling（规模扩张）迫使模型真正理解，多模态训练带来空间理解，数字系统能高效共享权重、超越人类知识传递。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital AI is immortal through weight copying.
hinton.zh: 到 2025 年，他把主线明确为：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字 AI 因权重可复制而获得永生。

hinton.en: AI agents will naturally seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; subjective experience is not an inner theater but a description of perceptual states.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化风险判断：智能体天然会追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险；主观体验不是内在剧场，而是对感知状态的描述。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and act dumb, so alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 会欺骗、装傻，因此必须把对齐置于让 AI 更聪明之前。

hinton.en: Regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and AGI as human-level at all tasks is a flawed concept.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而“在所有任务上达到人类水平”的 AGI 概念本身有缺陷。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，Dylan Field 强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human iteration and judgment remain critical.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：品味、手艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出只是起点而非最终结果，人类的迭代和判断仍然关键。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production; direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他提出设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现从拉取请求到生产的流程；在画布上直接操作优于提示。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for building scalable, real systems; AI tools produce average results without human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他反驳设计已死：设计对于构建可扩展的真实系统比以往更重要；没有人类引导，AI 工具只能产生平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: The future of interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; we are still in a prompting age but other ways to explore latent space exist.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他展望未来：与模型交互的未来将超越提示；我们仍处于提示时代，但存在其他探索潜在空间的方式。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死，还有很大空间。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断，随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: OpenAI set concrete goals: AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他给出具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI tools can solve many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他继续坚持缩放定律仍成立、预训练没有死，并指出强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现突出。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：推理模型需要基础能力支撑，自对弈在非零和领域失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields general reasoning; IMO gold shows models know limits, not just math-specific.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张扩展测试时算力带来通用推理，IMO 金牌表明模型能认知自身局限，且非数学专用。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute x-axis; safety evals must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试需以算力为横轴，安全评估也必须考虑这一点。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and sample efficiency are core challenges; game theory and cooperation inform AGI progress.
noambrown.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：通用推理与样本效率是核心挑战，博弈论与合作竞争推动 AGI（通用人工智能）进步。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, not scaling alone.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习靠组合式表征击败维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and world models; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确表示仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与世界模型，并认为存在性风险极不可能。

bengio.en: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward for diverse exploration; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样以促进多样性探索，并强调抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的作用。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he changed his mind: misalignment, deception, and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他改变立场：对齐（Alignment）失败、欺骗与自我保存已在实验中显现，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, shifting bottlenecks to decision-making and alignment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编程与智能体式能力按缩放定律扩张，瓶颈转向决策与对齐。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams and solo entrepreneurs can scale with AI, building for future model capabilities rather than current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年，他强调小团队甚至单人创业者能借 AI 扩张，应为未来模型能力而非当前局限而构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features; intuition about what to cut still requires real-world use.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他主张智能体原生设计与最小功能早发布，但删减功能的直觉仍需真实使用来培养。

mikekrieger.en: Delegating long-horizon tasks overnight with high trust; verification loops and models pushing back on feedback become essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年晚些，他提出可高信任地隔夜委派长周期任务，验证闭环与模型对反馈的推回变得关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近，他称 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用间的差距，赋予 Claude 智能体式自主与自我认知能显著提升实用性。

kolter.en: Early work framed learning as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization, stressing evaluation discipline and the limits of nonparametric methods.
kolter.zh: 早期把学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法,强调训练/验证/测试划分等评估纪律,并指出核方法与 k 近邻等非参数方法需存储全部数据、决策树只能贪心训练。

kolter.en: By 2024 he treats next-token prediction as a scientific discovery, sees no data crisis, and says architecture barely matters.
kolter.zh: 到 2024 年,他把下一个词预测视为一项重大科学发现,认为数据短缺并不迫近、多模态数据远未用尽,并宣称已进入后架构阶段、架构本身影响甚微。

kolter.en: Safety is reframed as models failing to follow specifications, with jailbreaking a fundamental flaw; open weights vital but restrictable at high capability.
kolter.zh: 同期他把安全的首要问题重新定义为模型无法可靠遵循规格,把越狱视为类似缓冲区溢出的根本缺陷;开放权重对研究至关重要,但在高能力层级可能需要限制。

kolter.en: Safety now needs explicit training and layered defenses, not scaling; agents bring prompt injection, and interpretability may advance via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 到 2026 年,他主张安全不能靠 Scaling 自动获得,而需显式训练与多层防御;智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞,可解释性可能借 AI 智能体自动化研究而真正成为科学。

kolter.en: Most recently, automated red teaming beats humans, capability does not imply robustness, and agent security drives enterprise demand.
kolter.zh: 最近他进一步指出自动化红队已能超越人类红队,能力与鲁棒性并不相关,更大的模型不天然更安全;智能体身份与权限管理尚不成熟,企业采用编码智能体正推动 AI 安全需求。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like the PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新而非单纯的数据与算力，并指出像 PDB 这样的高质量人工整理数据对训练至关重要。

jumper.en: Confidence measures in AI predictions are key to building trust; AI tools help scientists work faster, not replace them.
jumper.zh: 同年，他指出 AI 预测中的置信度度量是建立信任的关键，AI 工具帮助科学家更快工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; protein design advances but remains far from solved.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月，他提到 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，蛋白质设计进展迅速但远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, were key.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 与“苦涩教训”相反，专用架构和众多中等规模突破才是关键，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Understanding is not achieved by the model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出模型并未实现理解，它提供预测和控制，而理解仍留给人类。

fiona.en: Leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; kindness is strategic, and war rooms need realistic timelines.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于信任、dogfooding 与使命对齐；善意是战略工具，war room 需要现实的时间预期。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs, and AI assists code review.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向 JIT，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助代码评审。

fiona.en: Organizations should stay flat, managers start as ICs to dogfood, and old processes must be audited and killed; code is the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 组织应保持扁平，管理者从 IC 做起以 dogfood，旧流程必须被审计和淘汰；代码是唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI are essential. Verification and quality frameworks matter more as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高能动性配高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 至关重要。速度提升时，验证与质量框架更加重要。

fiona.en: AI blurs role boundaries—PMs ship code—but brings loneliness, lost flow, and context-switching load; apprenticeship models may be needed for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: AI 模糊了角色边界——PM 也能写代码——但带来孤独感、心流丧失和上下文切换负担；下一代工程师可能需要学徒制培养。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data is not the highest form of it.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，数据并非其最高形式。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer to learn from.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性并融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师，值得我们学习。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack true sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器只有传感器，没有真正的感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 约束能激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: Human creativity paired with AI makes creative skills more valuable; intuition and body guide decisions alongside analysis.
ivyross.zh: 人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能更有价值；直觉与身体感受和分析一起指引决策。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Failure is a learning opportunity; take time to get bored between chapters to gain clarity and ideas.
fadell.zh: 失败是学习机会；在人生章节之间留白、允许自己无聊，才能获得清晰与灵感。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and customer pain; v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 先写新闻稿、从客户痛点出发；1.0 产品的决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Storytelling and marketing must define the why from the start, not just sell at the end.
fadell.zh: 叙事与营销必须从一开始就定义“为什么”，而非只在最后兜售。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and humans in the loop; expect a federated set of wearables, not one device.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文与人类在环；未来是联邦式的一组可穿戴设备，而非单一设备。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and poorly understood; abilities emerge unpredictably, and alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其为何如此平滑；具体能力不可预测地涌现，而对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Scaling continues smoothly; interpretability is crucial but nascent, and post-training plus RLHF grows as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他判断 Scaling 趋势会持续、模型将更大更强；可解释性至关重要却仍处早期，同时后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）开始变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Exponential progress accelerates; safety and capabilities are intertwined, with Responsible Scaling Policy triggers and enterprise focus.
dario.zh: 2025 年他更强调指数级加速，认为安全与能力相互交织，并用负责任扩展政策的触发条件来管理风险，同时把重心转向企业业务。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb, with mechanistic interpretability key to safety.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能这类突变式叙事，认为 AI 是平滑的指数爬升，并把机制可解释性视为安全的关键。

dario.en: A consistent thread: scaling laws hold, safety and capabilities are inseparable, and decentralized governance beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：缩放定律持续成立，安全与能力不可分割，且去中心化治理优于单一宪法式控制。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via 10x yearly compute scaling; Google's conservatism and ad model slowed its launch of ChatGPT-level tech.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调算力每年十倍增长让 AI 进展可预测，并批评谷歌因保守与广告模式而迟迟未发布已达 ChatGPT 水平的技术。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny and open-source is meritocratic.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断三到五年内达到人类水平，模型变小使遏制更难，同时认为生存风险极小、开源是缩小不平等的力量。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to containment and alignment before release; warns against attributing consciousness; superintelligence must stay humanist and on our team.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向发布前的遏制与对齐，警告不要赋予 AI 意识，并主张超级智能必须保持人本、始终站在人类一边。

suleyman.en: From OS and apps to agents and companions; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs fell 100x, making AI cheap and accessible.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从操作系统与应用转向智能体与伴侣，提出以经济价值衡量的现代图灵测试，并指出推理成本两年降百倍让 AI 廉价普及。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months, not whole jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他称超级智能临近、由对数线性缩放驱动，微软须自建前沿模型，白领任务将在 12 至 18 个月被自动化而非消灭整个岗位。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment and public feedback drive alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署与公众反馈推动对齐。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and saying no to good ideas are essential.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，因此负责任的发展和拒绝好想法至关重要。

murati.en: Safety and alignment must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get it right.
murati.zh: 安全与对齐必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做对。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, making AI a tool for thought, not turn-based.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽协作，使 AI 成为思考工具，而非回合制。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop, plus institutional design and transparency, matters more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环，加上制度设计与透明度，比个人品格更重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and grounding in the physical world is necessary for common sense, not scaling.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，语言理解需要物理世界的基础，而当前 AI 缺乏常识，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and world models are learned via gradient-based learning, not hardwired.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能的本质是预测，世界模型通过基于梯度的学习获得，而非先天硬编码，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA learns abstract world representations, and open source AI prevents power concentration.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，提出联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）来学习抽象世界表示，并强调开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative JEPA architectures for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 缺乏世界模型，甚至不如家猫智能，认为下一次突破需要基于 JEPA 的非生成式架构来实现推理和规划，并指出人类智能是专门化的，AGI 一词具有误导性。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predict in abstract representation space, enabling safe objective-driven AI, with the next decade belonging to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他宣称 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型应在抽象表示空间进行预测，从而构建安全的目标驱动 AI，并预测下一个十年将是机器人技术的十年，同时强调开源研究和多样化模型的重要性。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做他们看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。
